name: Play and Exploration Grant Planning Template
shortDescriptionEnglish: Provide proposed expenditures for the Play and Exploration Grant for each domain of holistic development (expenditures may overlap in more than one domain). Describe how the quality of the early learning program will be enhanced as a result of the expenditure.
